# Muhammad Hazqeel Abdullah

> Full-stack developer and AI systems builder in the United Arab Emirates. Builds booking portals, CRMs, web infrastructure and AI systems for businesses, plus products and game server systems.

## Featured work
- Shabab Al Khor Mobility Car Wash (https://shababalkhor.vercel.app/, Khorfakkan, UAE): end-to-end appointment booking portal and custom CRM with online payments and real-time scheduling. Role: full-stack developer & solutions architect.
- Micro Freelance Hub (https://micro-freelance-hub.vercel.app/): full-stack Next.js and Supabase marketplace for student freelancers.
- Chassis Decoder (https://chassis-decoder.vercel.app/): automotive VIN and chassis number decoder.
- Pixel Planet Healers (https://pixel-planet-healers.lovable.app/): interactive environmental web game.
- Developer Portfolio / Lab (https://hazqeel.vercel.app/): this site, including an interactive exploded view of an AI system (illustrative architecture).

## Infrastructure, automation and game servers
- Virgo Lubes (https://www.virgolubes.com/): corporate website, technical SEO, analytics, domains, DNS and hosting. Role: digital infrastructure lead & web developer.
- Minecraft (Java, Spigot/Paper plugins, Nodes SMP network) and Roblox (Lua) development.
- Local multi-agent workflows with Ollama; scheduled content and order-processing pipelines.
